messages:
jia: Quick heads-up — seen a consistent latency bump (~12-18%) on L4/T4 after the kernel_selector reorder landed this morning. A100/H100 unchanged.
ryan: can you paste the perf snippet / kernel choices for a representative request?
jia: putting a short trace from the local perf run (same model, batch=4, seqlen=64). Notice the selector picks `attn_kernel_v3` on L4/T4 but `attn_opt_v2` on A100/H100.
```
# device: L4
kernel_order: [attn_kernel_v3, attn_kernel_v1, attn_generic]
latency: 22.7ms per token
kv_cache_touch: 3.1ms
batching_overhead: 1.6ms

# device: A100
kernel_order: [attn_opt_v2, attn_kernel_v1]
latency: 18.9ms per token
kv_cache_touch: 1.2ms
batching_overhead: 1.4ms
```
jia: Also saw more frequent KV cache evictions on L4 when seqlen < 128 due to our eviction heuristic interacting with the new kernel's working set. That increases memory churn and shows up in p99.
meera: rough theory: attn_kernel_v3 has worse L2/L3 locality on Maxwell/older Ampere-Lite -> more cache miss latency, plus its register pressure forces smaller batch concurrency.
ryan: can we force kernel preference by device_family in selector config to test? e.g. `device_family: { L4: prefer: attn_kernel_v1 }` — try to confirm if perf returns to baseline.
jia: did a quick patch to set prefer for L4/T4 to attn_kernel_v1, retested: latency drops to ~19.8ms (closer to A100). So selector reorder is the root cause.
tom: that's useful. we should add a short-term fallback preset keyed by device_family + seqlen range. Something like: `preset: crossarch-lowmem-l4` with fields `seqlen_threshold: 96`, `kernel_priority: [attn_kernel_v1, attn_kernel_v3]`, `batch_timeout_ms: 2`.
ryan: agree. two questions: 1) do we want to bake this into global autotune, or keep as explicit per-device preset? 2) how do we detect in prod when the selector picks a slower kernel often (so we can auto-roll a fallback)?
jia: for (1) prefer per-device presets for now — autotune can propose later after more samples. For (2) we can add a small sampling metric: `kernel_selection_delta_ms` per device_family and per model -> if average delta > 5ms and >100 samples in 1h, trigger alert.
meera: adding to SRE checklist: watch p99 token latency and `kv_eviction_rate` for small seqlen traffic. Those two together correlate with this regression.
```
# quick command I ran locally
redwood-runtime profile --device L4 --model gpt-small --batch 4 --seqlen 64 --selector-log
```
ryan: can someone open a short PR to revert the reorder in selector until we ship the device-family preset? revert should be trivial. I'll own the canary test and perf dashboard update.
jia: I'll open PR to add L4/T4 preset + revert patch, will include unit test for selector order and a small perf harness test.
tom: infra-bot, can you schedule a CI perf job to run the L4 vs A100 baseline nightly until we stabilize?
infra-bot: scheduled perf-ci/job-1258: nightly L4-A100 kernel-comparison, retention 14d.
meera: also flagging on-call in case customers hit degraded latency. @oncall please monitor the alert I mentioned. :rotating_light:
ryan: action items: jia PR for preset + revert (ETA today), ryan will run canary (ETA tomorrow AM), meera add SLO alert rule (ETA today), tom will add perf-ci job (done).
jia: thanks all — copying logs into the issue: https://internal/issue/RED-3831 for follow-ups.
ryan: :thumbsup:
meera: :+1:
